def _as_i32(v):
    if isinstance(v, int):
        return fx.arith.constant(v)
    v = fx.arith.unwrap(v)
    t = v.type
    if isinstance(t, ir.IntegerType):
        if t.width == 32:
            return v
        if t.width > 32:
            return std_arith.TruncIOp(T.i32, v).result
        return std_arith.ExtSIOp(T.i32, v).result
    return std_arith.IndexCastOp(T.i32, v).result


def _rsrc(tensor, num_records_bytes):
    buf = rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(tensor, max_size=False, num_records_bytes=num_records_bytes)
    return fx.arith.unwrap(rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(fx.get_iter(buf)))


def _aux(v):
    return ir.IntegerAttr.get(T.i32, v)


def _bload(res_ty, rsrc, byte_off, aux=0):
    return rocdl_d.RawPtrBufferLoadOp(res_ty, rsrc, _as_i32(byte_off), fx.arith.constant(0), aux=_aux(aux)).result


def _bstore(data, rsrc, byte_off, aux=0):
    rocdl_d.RawPtrBufferStoreOp(
        fx.arith.unwrap(data), rsrc, _as_i32(byte_off), fx.arith.constant(0), aux=_aux(aux)
    )


def _lds_ptr(addr_i64):
    v = fx.arith.unwrap(addr_i64)
    return llvm.IntToPtrOp(ir.Type.parse("!llvm.ptr<3>"), v).result


def _gep(base_ptr, byte_offset=None, static_byte_offset=0):
    base_ptr = fx.arith.unwrap(base_ptr)
    i8 = ir.IntegerType.get_signless(8)
    if byte_offset is None:
        return llvm.GEPOp(base_ptr.type, base_ptr, [], [int(static_byte_offset)], i8, None).result
    off = fx.arith.unwrap(byte_offset)
    return llvm.GEPOp(base_ptr.type, base_ptr, [off], [-(2**31)], i8, None).result


def _i64c(v):
    return std_arith.ConstantOp(T.i64, ir.IntegerAttr.get(T.i64, v)).result


@functools.cache
def _build(m, n, k, BM, BN, WM, WN, STAGES, SPLIT, BPOL, BK=64):
    WAVES = WM * WN
    THREADS = WAVES * 64
    WARP_M = BM // WM
    WARP_N = BN // WN
    MS = WARP_M // 16
    NS = WARP_N // 16
    assert MS * 16 * WM == BM and NS * 16 * WN == BN
    NF = MS * NS
    N_BLOCKS = n // BN
    assert N_BLOCKS * BN == n
    M_BLOCKS = (m + BM - 1) // BM
    TILES = M_BLOCKS * N_BLOCKS
    assert k % BK == 0
    KBLK = k // BK
    LOOPS = KBLK // SPLIT
    REM = KBLK % SPLIT
    assert LOOPS >= STAGES >= 2
    K_STEPS = BK // 32
    KV = BK // 8
    A_CH = BM * KV
    B_CH = BN * KV
    C_CH = BM * BN // 8
    A_DMA = (A_CH + THREADS - 1) // THREADS
    B_DMA = (B_CH + THREADS - 1) // THREADS
    C_VECS = (C_CH + THREADS - 1) // THREADS
    for ch in (A_CH, B_CH, C_CH):
        assert ch % 64 == 0 and ch >= THREADS
    A_TAIL = (A_CH - (A_DMA - 1) * THREADS) // 64
    B_TAIL = (B_CH - (B_DMA - 1) * THREADS) // 64
    WAIT = A_DMA - (A_TAIL < WAVES) + B_DMA - (B_TAIL < WAVES)
    assert (STAGES - 2) * (A_DMA + B_DMA) < 63
    C_XV = BN // 8
    PART = BM * BN
    PROD = TILES * SPLIT
    plane_bytes = SPLIT * TILES * PART * 4
    ws_bytes = plane_bytes + TILES * _CNT_LINE
    ws_numel = ws_bytes // 4
    GRID = (TILES, SPLIT, 1)

    AS_ELEMS = STAGES * BM * BK
    BS_ELEMS = STAGES * BN * BK
    CS_ELEMS = BM * BN
    FLAG_ELEM = max(AS_ELEMS + BS_ELEMS, CS_ELEMS)
    LDS_ELEMS = FLAG_ELEM + 64

    @fx.struct
    class SharedStorage:
        buf: fx.Array[fx.BFloat16, LDS_ELEMS, 16]

    @flyc.kernel(known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1])
    def gemm_family_splitk(A: fx.Tensor, B: fx.Tensor, C: fx.Tensor, W: fx.Tensor):
        bf16x8 = fx.Vector.make_type(8, fx.BFloat16)
        a_rsrc = _rsrc(A, m * k * 2)
        b_rsrc = _rsrc(B, n * k * 2)
        c_rsrc = _rsrc(C, m * n * 2)
        w_rsrc = _rsrc(W, ws_bytes)
        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(SharedStorage)
        a_lds_ptr = lds.buf.peek().ptr
        b_lds_ptr = a_lds_ptr + fx.Int64(AS_ELEMS)
        c_lds_ptr = a_lds_ptr
        a_lds_i64 = fx.Int64(fx.ptrtoint(a_lds_ptr))
        b_lds_i64 = fx.Int64(fx.ptrtoint(b_lds_ptr))
        flag_lds = _gep(_lds_ptr(a_lds_i64), static_byte_offset=FLAG_ELEM * 2)

        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        wid = tid // 64
        lane = tid % 64
        bid = fx.block_idx.x
        s_idx = fx.block_idx.y
        # (tile, split) pairs dispatch round-robin over 8 XCDs: each XCD takes a contiguous tile-major run, so the
        # splits of one tile start together on one XCD and reach the fold at about the same time
        lin = bid + s_idx * TILES
        x_q, x_r = PROD // 8, PROD % 8
        xcd = lin % 8
        logical = xcd * x_q + arith.select(xcd < x_r, xcd, x_r) + lin // 8
        s_idx = logical % SPLIT
        tile_id = logical // SPLIT
        # tiles that share a B column strip are adjacent, so they land on one XCD
        block_n = tile_id // M_BLOCKS
        block_m = tile_id % M_BLOCKS
        m_off = block_m * BM
        n_off = block_n * BN
        if const_expr(REM == 0):
            ks_begin = _as_i32(s_idx * (LOOPS * BK))
            n_iter = LOOPS - (STAGES - 1)
        else:
            # the first REM splits take one extra k-block
            s_i = fx.Int32(s_idx)
            ks_begin = _as_i32((s_i * LOOPS + arith.select(s_i < fx.Int32(REM), s_i, fx.Int32(REM))) * BK)
            n_iter = arith.index_cast(
                T.index, _as_i32(arith.select(s_i < fx.Int32(REM), fx.Int32(LOOPS + 1), fx.Int32(LOOPS)) - fx.Int32(STAGES - 1))
            )

        def kpos(j):
            return ks_begin + _as_i32(fx.Int32(j) * BK)

        warp_m = wid // WN * WARP_M
        warp_n = wid % WN * WARP_N
        frag_r = lane % 16
        frag_k = lane // 16 * 8

        warp_offset = rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i64, arith.index_cast(T.i64, fx.Index(wid) * fx.Index(64 * 16)))
        wid_s = None
        if const_expr(A_TAIL < WAVES or B_TAIL < WAVES):
            wid_s = fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, _as_i32(wid)))

        def barrier(vmcnt):
            llvm.InlineAsmOp(None, [], f"s_waitcnt vmcnt({vmcnt})\n\ts_barrier", "", has_side_effects=True)

        def dma(rsrc, lds_ptr, goff, pol="sc0"):
            llvm.InlineAsmOp(
                None,
                [lds_ptr, goff, rsrc],
                f"s_mov_b32 m0, $0\n\tbuffer_load_dwordx4 $1, $2, 0 offen {pol} lds",
                "s,v,s",
                has_side_effects=True,
            )

        def dma_tile(rsrc, lds_i64, rows, row_off, row_lim, count, tail, k_off, stage, pol="sc0"):
            lds_p = None
            for ii in range_constexpr(count):
                gtid = THREADS * ii + tid
                r = gtid // KV
                col_bytes = (gtid % KV * 16) ^ (r % KV * 16)
                row = row_off + r
                if const_expr(row_lim is not None):
                    row = arith.select(
                        arith.cmpi(arith.CmpIPredicate.ult, fx.Index(row), fx.Index(row_lim)),
                        fx.Index(row),
                        fx.Index(0),
                    )
                goff = _as_i32(fx.Index(row) * fx.Index(k * 2)) + _as_i32(k_off * 2) + _as_i32(col_bytes)
                if const_expr(lds_p is None):
                    base = lds_i64 + fx.Int64(arith.index_cast(T.i64, fx.Index(stage) * fx.Index(rows * BK * 2)))
                    lds_p = _gep(_lds_ptr(base), warp_offset)
                else:
                    lds_p = _gep(lds_p, static_byte_offset=THREADS * 16)
                if const_expr(ii == count - 1 and tail < WAVES):
                    if wid_s < fx.Int32(tail):
                        dma(rsrc, lds_p, goff, pol)
                else:
                    dma(rsrc, lds_p, goff, pol)

        def dma_a(k_off, stage):
            dma_tile(a_rsrc, a_lds_i64, BM, m_off, m if M_BLOCKS * BM > m else None, A_DMA, A_TAIL, k_off, stage)

        def dma_b(k_off, stage):
            dma_tile(b_rsrc, b_lds_i64, BN, n_off, None, B_DMA, B_TAIL, k_off, stage, BPOL)

        def lds_frag(base_ptr, rows, stage, row, kcol):
            col_bytes = (kcol * 2) ^ (row % KV * 16)
            off = fx.Int64(stage) * (rows * BK) + fx.Int64(row) * BK + fx.Int64(col_bytes // 2)
            return fx.ptr_load(base_ptr + off, result_type=bf16x8)

        def compute(stage, frags):
            s = fx.Index(stage)
            out = [x for x in frags]
            for kk in range_constexpr(K_STEPS):
                kcol = kk * 32 + frag_k
                b_fr = [lds_frag(b_lds_ptr, BN, s, warp_n + j * 16 + frag_r, kcol) for j in range_constexpr(NS)]
                a_fr = [lds_frag(a_lds_ptr, BM, s, warp_m + i * 16 + frag_r, kcol) for i in range_constexpr(MS)]
                rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
                for i in range_constexpr(MS):
                    for j in range_constexpr(NS):
                        out[i * NS + j] = rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16(
                            T.vec(4, T.f32), [a_fr[i], b_fr[j], out[i * NS + j], 0, 0, 0]
                        )
            return out

        def hot_loop_scheduler():
            for _ in range_constexpr(B_DMA + A_DMA):
                rocdl.sched_vmem(1)
            for _ in range_constexpr(K_STEPS):
                for _ in range_constexpr(NS + MS):
                    rocdl.sched_dsrd(1)
                for _ in range_constexpr(MS):
                    rocdl.sched_mfma(NS)
            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)

        acc0 = [arith.constant_vector(0.0, T.vec(4, T.f32))] * NF

        def mainloop():
            for st in range_constexpr(STAGES - 1):
                dma_b(kpos(st), st)
                dma_a(kpos(st), st)
            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
            init_state = [fx.Int32(0), arith.constant(0, index=True)] + acc0
            for bki, state in range(0, n_iter, 1, init=init_state):
                k_offset = state[0]
                cur = fx.Index(state[1])
                frags = state[2:]
                nxt = (cur + 1) % STAGES
                wst = (cur + STAGES - 1) % STAGES
                barrier((STAGES - 2) * WAIT)
                dma_b(kpos(k_offset + (STAGES - 1)), wst)
                dma_a(kpos(k_offset + (STAGES - 1)), wst)
                new = compute(cur, frags)
                hot_loop_scheduler()
                results = yield [k_offset + fx.Int32(1), nxt] + new
            cur = fx.Index(results[1])
            m_frags = results[2:]
            for st in range_constexpr(STAGES - 1):
                barrier((STAGES - 2 - st) * WAIT)
                m_frags = compute(cur, m_frags)
                cur = (cur + 1) % STAGES
            return m_frags

        c_frags = mainloop()

        # fragment-major planes: (split, tile, wave, frag, lane) x f32x4
        frag_base = (tile_id * WAVES + wid) * NF

        def plane_off(sp, f):
            return ((sp * (TILES * WAVES * NF) + frag_base + f) * 64 + lane) * 16

        for f in range_constexpr(NF):
            _bstore(Vector(c_frags[f]), w_rsrc, plane_off(s_idx, f), _SC01)
        rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
        gpu.barrier()

        if tid == fx.Int32(0):
            # launch tag: dispatch id plus queue address bits (ids restart on another queue)
            did = llvm.call_intrinsic(T.i64, "llvm.amdgcn.dispatch.id", [], [], [])
            qp = llvm.call_intrinsic(ir.Type.parse("!llvm.ptr<4>"), "llvm.amdgcn.queue.ptr", [], [], [])
            qpi = llvm.PtrToIntOp(T.i64, qp).result
            tag = std_arith.AndIOp(
                std_arith.AddIOp(did, std_arith.MulIOp(qpi, _i64c(_TAG_MUL - (1 << 64))).result).result,
                _i64c(_TAG_MASK),
            ).result
            tag_base = std_arith.ShLIOp(tag, _i64c(8)).result
            wptr = fx.to_llvm_ptr(fx.get_iter(W))
            cnt_off = std_arith.ExtSIOp(T.i64, _as_i32(tile_id * _CNT_LINE + plane_bytes)).result
            cptr = _gep(wptr, cnt_off)
            cur = llvm.LoadOp(
                T.i64, cptr, alignment=8, ordering=llvm.AtomicOrdering.monotonic, syncscope="agent"
            ).result
            stale = std_arith.CmpIOp(
                std_arith.CmpIPredicate.ne, std_arith.ShRUIOp(cur, _i64c(8)).result, tag
            ).result
            # a word from another launch is reset to this launch's tag with count 0; a word that already holds the
            # tag is left alone (its expected value is one no tagged word can hold)
            expect = std_arith.SelectOp(stale, cur, _i64c(-1)).result
            llvm.cmpxchg(
                cptr,
                expect,
                tag_base,
                llvm.AtomicOrdering.monotonic,
                llvm.AtomicOrdering.monotonic,
                syncscope="agent",
                alignment=8,
            )
            old = llvm.atomicrmw(
                llvm.AtomicBinOp.add,
                cptr,
                _i64c(1),
                llvm.AtomicOrdering.monotonic,
                syncscope="agent",
                alignment=8,
            )
            last = std_arith.CmpIOp(
                std_arith.CmpIPredicate.eq, old, std_arith.OrIOp(tag_base, _i64c(SPLIT - 1)).result
            ).result
            llvm.StoreOp(std_arith.ExtUIOp(T.i32, last).result, flag_lds, alignment=4)
        gpu.barrier()
        is_last = fx.Int32(llvm.LoadOp(T.i32, flag_lds, alignment=4).result)

        def fold_sums(own_sp):
            sums = []
            for f in range_constexpr(NF):
                tot = None
                for sp in range_constexpr(SPLIT):
                    if const_expr(sp == own_sp):
                        v = Vector(c_frags[f])
                    else:
                        v = Vector(_bload(T.f32x4, w_rsrc, plane_off(fx.Int32(sp), f), _SC01))
                    tot = v if tot is None else tot + v
                sums.append(tot)
            return sums

        def write_c(sums):
            gpu.barrier()
            c_m = lane // 16 * 4
            c_n = lane % 16
            for i in range_constexpr(MS):
                for j in range_constexpr(NS):
                    cast = sums[i * NS + j].to(fx.BFloat16)
                    for e in range_constexpr(4):
                        row = warp_m + i * 16 + c_m + e
                        col = warp_n + j * 16 + c_n
                        fx.ptr_store(cast[e], c_lds_ptr + fx.Int64(row * BN + col))
            gpu.barrier()
            for i in range_constexpr(C_VECS):
                g = THREADS * i + tid
                r = g // C_XV
                cc = g % C_XV * 8
                row = m_off + r
                if const_expr(i == C_VECS - 1 and C_CH % THREADS != 0):
                    row = arith.select(g < fx.Int32(C_CH), fx.Int32(row), fx.Int32(m))
                if row < fx.Int32(m):
                    v = fx.ptr_load(c_lds_ptr + fx.Int64(r * BN + cc), result_type=bf16x8)
                    _bstore(v, c_rsrc, (row * n + n_off + cc) * 2)

        # one uniform branch per split index: the folder keeps its own partial in registers, reads the other
        # planes, and still adds in split order, so every folder produces the same bits
        sel = is_last * (fx.Int32(s_idx) + fx.Int32(1))
        for so in range_constexpr(SPLIT):
            if sel == fx.Int32(so + 1):
                write_c(fold_sums(so))

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(A: fx.Tensor, B: fx.Tensor, C: fx.Tensor, W: fx.Tensor, stream: fx.Stream):
        gemm_family_splitk(A, B, C, W).launch(grid=GRID, block=(THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream)

    return launch, ws_numel


@functools.cache
def _fits(m, n, k, BM, BN, WM, WN, STAGES, SPLIT, BK=64):
    """_build's own preconditions, checked without building."""
    threads = WM * WN * 64
    if BM % (16 * WM) or BN % (16 * WN) or n % BN or k % BK:
        return False
    if not k // BK // SPLIT >= STAGES >= 2:
        return False
    chans = (BM * BK // 8, BN * BK // 8, BM * BN // 8)
    if any(ch % 64 or ch < threads for ch in chans):
        return False
    dma = sum(-(-ch // threads) for ch in chans[:2])
    return (STAGES - 2) * dma < 63


def _default_cfg(m, n, k):
    """A split-K FlyDSL configuration for a shape _CONFIGS does not list: the smallest row tile that holds m, the
    widest column tile that divides n, and enough K splits to give each CU about one workgroup."""
    rows = [bm for bm in (16, 32, 64, 128) if bm >= min(m, 128)] or [128]
    for BM in rows + [32, 64, 128]:
        for BN, WN in ((64, 2), (128, 4), (48, 1), (32, 2), (16, 1)):
            tiles = (n // BN) * (-(-m // BM)) if n % BN == 0 else 0
            if not tiles:
                continue
            kblk = k // 64
            for SPLIT in sorted({max(1, min(8, 256 // tiles, kblk // 3)), 1}, reverse=True):
                for STAGES in (3, 2):
                    cfg = (BM, BN, 1, WN, STAGES, SPLIT, "sc0")
                    if _fits(m, n, k, *cfg[:6]):
                        return cfg
    raise NotImplementedError(f"no FlyDSL configuration for m={m} n={n} k={k}")


def _plan(m, n, k):
    cfg = _CONFIGS.get((m, n, k)) or _default_cfg(m, n, k)
    return _build(m, n, k, *cfg)


def run(*, a, b, trans_b, bias, out_dtype, out):
    plan = None
    tiled = None
    hgemm = None
    rt = None
    mrt = None
    if (
        trans_b
        and bias is None
        and a.dtype == torch.bfloat16
        and b.dtype == torch.bfloat16
        and out.dtype == torch.bfloat16
        and a.is_contiguous()
        and b.is_contiguous()
        and out.is_contiguous()
    ):
        shape = (a.shape[0], b.shape[0], a.shape[1])
        rt = _rt_class(*shape)
        mrt = _mrt_class(*shape)
        if rt is not None or mrt is not None:
            pass
        elif shape in _HGEMM:
            hgemm = _hgemm(*shape, *_HGEMM[shape])
        elif shape in _TILED:
            tiled = _tiled(*shape, **_TILED[shape])
        else:
            plan = _plan(*shape)
    if mrt is not None:
        m, n, k = shape
        kind, cfg = mrt
        stream = fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(a.device))
        if kind == "band":
            _band(n, k, **cfg)(a, b, out, m, stream)
        elif kind == "hg":
            _hgemm_rt(n, k, **cfg)(a, b, out, m, -(-m // cfg["TILE_M"]) * (n // cfg["TILE_N"]), stream)
        else:
            _tiled_rt(n, k, **cfg)(a, b, out, out, m, -(-m // cfg["BM"]) * (n // cfg["BN"]), stream)
        return
    if rt is not None:
        cfg, grid = rt
        _rt_fn(shape[1], shape[2], cfg)(a, b, out, out, shape[0], grid, fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(a.device)))
        return
    if hgemm is not None:
        hgemm(a, b, out, stream=fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(a.device)))
        return
    if tiled is not None:
        fn, ws_numel = tiled
        ws = torch.empty((ws_numel,), dtype=torch.float32, device=a.device) if ws_numel else out
        fn(a, b, out, ws, fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(a.device)))
        return
    if plan is None:
        # Every compute path is FlyDSL: inputs outside the contract this kernel serves (bf16, b given as (n, k),
        # contiguous, no bias) are not computed here.
        raise NotImplementedError("FlyDSL bf16 GEMM: needs bf16 contiguous a, b as (n, k), no bias")
    launch, ws_numel = plan
    ws = torch.empty((ws_numel,), dtype=torch.float32, device=a.device)
    launch(a, b, out, ws, stream=fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(a.device)))

"""Large-m bf16 GEMM out = a @ b.T on BM x BN tiles of four waves.

Each wave owns a (BM / 2) x (BN / 2) block of 16x16 fp32 accumulator fragments: the first 64 live in AGPRs, the rest
(tiles past 256x256 outputs) in arch VGPRs through inline-asm MFMAs. A and B stream into a two-stage XOR-swizzled LDS
ring through buffer_load ... lds DMA; one barrier per 64-wide K step, between its two 32-wide halves, so the next
stage's first fragments load under this step's MFMAs. With A3, A alone streams through a three-stage ring: A block
kb + 3 loads into the stage block kb frees, two K steps ahead of its MFMAs, and each mid-step wait leaves that block's
A_DMA loads in flight (a cold A panel's HBM latency outlasts one K step); B3 is the same for B (A's refill issues
first, so the wait leaves B's B_DMA loads in flight). With PF, each refill also issues one 4-byte LDS-DMA probe per
row of K block kb + PF into a dummy LDS slot, so that block's lines are in L2 when its refill comes; vmcnt is in
issue order, so the mid-step wait leaves those P probes in flight. With KROT, the XCDs start their K walk at KROT
points spread over K and wrap, so they miss on one B block at different times and the later ones hit the MALL. Tiles
run in an XCD-major order, GROUP_N column (or row) blocks at a time. When the tiles fill whole rounds of the CUs the grid is persistent and a tile's last K step loads the next
tile's first stage under the epilogue. With SPLIT 2 a grid of at most half a round splits K two ways: each
split stores its fp32 partial, and the split that arrives last on a launch-tagged per-tile counter adds the other
split's partial to its own and rounds once to bf16 (no workgroup waits on another). With EARLY, the epilogue passes
of the fragment rows the last half K step finishes first stage, read back and store between that half's remaining
MFMAs; EPF sets the fragment rows per pass (past a wave's half of the second stage, a grid with no next tile under the
epilogue stages in its quarter of the whole ring). DMA_FRONT=2: in a walk's last half step under EARLY, the next tile's
first-stage loads issue before the first early pass's stores rather than spread over the whole half.
"""

import functools

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
import torch
from flydsl._mlir import ir
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import arith as std_arith
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm
from flydsl._mlir.dialects import rocdl as rocdl_d
from flydsl.expr import arith, const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
from flydsl.expr.typing import T, Vector

_XCDS = 8
_CUS = 256
_BK = 64
_RD_GAP = 2  # MFMAs between fragment reads of a half K step
_RD_OFF = 32  # MFMA of the first read in a half that also issues DMAs
_VMCNT_MAX = 63  # an s_waitcnt vmcnt that waits on no load
_OOB = 0x7FFFFFF0  # byte offset past every buffer: the access is dropped
_C_AUX = 2  # default C store policy, nt: written tiles do not evict A and B panels still in use
_AGPR_FRAGS = 64  # accumulator fragments the AGPR file holds; the rest live in arch VGPRs
_JIT_BARRIER_GAP = 4  # JIT_A loop: MFMAs between a half's last A read and its barrier
_SC01 = 17  # sc0 | sc1: system scope, past the non-coherent caches
_CNT_LINE = 128  # bytes per tile counter: one cache line each
_TAG_MUL = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15  # odd: mixes the queue address into the dispatch id
_TAG_MASK = (1 << 55) - 1


def _as_i32(v):
    if isinstance(v, int):
        return fx.arith.constant(v)
    v = fx.arith.unwrap(v)
    t = v.type
    if isinstance(t, ir.IntegerType):
        if t.width == 32:
            return v
        if t.width > 32:
            return std_arith.TruncIOp(T.i32, v).result
        return std_arith.ExtSIOp(T.i32, v).result
    return std_arith.IndexCastOp(T.i32, v).result


def _rsrc(tensor, num_records_bytes):
    buf = rocdl.make_buffer_tensor(tensor, max_size=False, num_records_bytes=num_records_bytes)
    return fx.arith.unwrap(rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(fx.get_iter(buf)))


def _bstore(data, rsrc, byte_off, aux=0):
    rocdl_d.RawPtrBufferStoreOp(
        fx.arith.unwrap(data), rsrc, _as_i32(byte_off), fx.arith.constant(0), aux=ir.IntegerAttr.get(T.i32, aux)
    )


def _bload(res_ty, rsrc, byte_off, aux=0):
    return rocdl_d.RawPtrBufferLoadOp(
        res_ty, rsrc, _as_i32(byte_off), fx.arith.constant(0), aux=ir.IntegerAttr.get(T.i32, aux)
    ).result


def _i64c(v):
    return std_arith.ConstantOp(T.i64, ir.IntegerAttr.get(T.i64, v)).result


def _lds_ptr(addr_i64):
    return llvm.IntToPtrOp(ir.Type.parse("!llvm.ptr<3>"), fx.arith.unwrap(addr_i64)).result


def _gep(base_ptr, byte_offset):
    base_ptr = fx.arith.unwrap(base_ptr)
    i8 = ir.IntegerType.get_signless(8)
    return llvm.GEPOp(base_ptr.type, base_ptr, [fx.arith.unwrap(byte_offset)], [-(2**31)], i8, None).result


def _build(m, n, k, BM, BN, GROUP_N, SPLIT, ROW_GROUPS, LATE_READS, ONE_TILE, JIT_A, PF, PF_SPLIT, XFER, C_AUX, A3, B3, KROT, EPF=0, EARLY=0, E_RG=2, E_SG=2, DMA_FRONT=0, STAGGER=0, STAG_MODE=0, STAG_N=1, WALK_RT=False, DERIVE=False, WM=2, WN=2):
    # m None: m is a kernel argument (rows past it masked) and the grid a launch argument; WALK_RT picks the
    # persistent walk over whole rounds of tiles, else one tile per workgroup
    MRT = m is None
    WAVES = WM * WN
    THREADS = WAVES * 64
    WARP_M = BM // WM
    WARP_N = BN // WN
    MS = WARP_M // 16
    NS = WARP_N // 16
    NF = MS * NS
    assert MS * 16 * WM == BM and NS * 16 * WN == BN
    N_BLOCKS = (n + BN - 1) // BN
    # B rows past n read zeros and C columns past n are dropped
    N_TAIL = N_BLOCKS * BN != n
    if MRT:
        assert not ROW_GROUPS and SPLIT == 1 and not XFER and not STAGGER and not PF and not JIT_A
        assert N_BLOCKS % GROUP_N == 0
        # stand-ins for the compile-time checks below: a walk's tile count is a multiple of 256 past one round
        M_BLOCKS = 2 * _CUS if WALK_RT else 1
    else:
        M_BLOCKS = (m + BM - 1) // BM
        assert (M_BLOCKS if ROW_GROUPS else N_BLOCKS) % GROUP_N == 0
    TILES = M_BLOCKS * N_BLOCKS
    LOOPS = k // _BK
    assert LOOPS * _BK == k and LOOPS % 2 == 0 and LOOPS >= 4
    if SPLIT == 1:
        # whole rounds walk persistently: workgroup b takes tiles b, b + 256, ...; otherwise (or with ONE_TILE: the
        # walk's next-tile state spills a tile past 64 fragments) one tile per workgroup
        HEAD = _CUS if TILES % _CUS == 0 and not ONE_TILE else TILES
        ROUNDS = (TILES + HEAD - 1) // HEAD
        TAIL = 0
    else:
        # every tile splits K two ways; each split is one work item on a workgroup of its own
        assert SPLIT == 2 and TILES * SPLIT <= _CUS
        HEAD, ROUNDS, TAIL = _CUS, 0, TILES
    PROD = TAIL * SPLIT
    assert PROD <= _CUS
    GRID = HEAD if ROUNDS else PROD
    KB_S = LOOPS // SPLIT
    assert KB_S * SPLIT == LOOPS and KB_S % 2 == 0 and KB_S >= 4
    PART = BM * BN * 4  # bytes of one split's fp32 partial tile
    plane_bytes = PROD * PART
    ws_bytes = plane_bytes + TAIL * _CNT_LINE if SPLIT > 1 else 0
    KV = _BK // 8
    A_CH = BM * KV
    B_CH = BN * KV
    assert A_CH % THREADS == 0 and B_CH % THREADS == 0
    A_DMA = A_CH // THREADS
    B_DMA = B_CH // THREADS
    AS_ELEMS = (3 if A3 else 2) * BM * _BK
    BS_ELEMS = (3 if B3 else 2) * BN * _BK
    CP = WARP_N + 8  # staging pitch: 16-byte aligned rows, banks shifted per row
    # fragment rows per epilogue pass: as many as fit in a wave's half of the second ring stage
    EP_F = max(f for f in (1, 2, 3, 4) if f <= MS and f * 16 * CP <= min(BM, BN) * _BK // (WAVES // 2))
    WALK0 = WALK_RT if MRT else (SPLIT == 1 and TILES % _CUS == 0 and not ONE_TILE and TILES > _CUS)
    # EPF: a grid that loads no next tile under the epilogue has its whole ring free there: a wave stages in its
    # quarter of it, EPF fragment rows per pass
    WIDE_EP = False
    if EPF:
        EP_F = min(EPF, MS)
        WIDE_EP = EP_F * 16 * CP > min(BM, BN) * _BK // (WAVES // 2)
        assert not WIDE_EP or (not WALK0 and SPLIT == 1 and EP_F * 16 * CP <= (AS_ELEMS + BS_ELEMS) // WAVES)
    # EARLY: (pass, MFMA slot of its staging writes) of the epilogue passes that go out under the last half step
    EARLY_SLOTS = []
    for p_ in range((MS + EP_F - 1) // EP_F - 1) if EARLY else []:
        t0_ = min(MS, p_ * EP_F + EP_F) * NS - 1 + EARLY
        # a pass with arch-VGPR fragments waits for the post-loop s_nop: the hazard recognizer cannot see an
        # inline-asm MFMA's result
        if t0_ + E_RG + E_SG > MS * NS - 2 or min(MS, p_ * EP_F + EP_F) * NS > _AGPR_FRAGS:
            break
        EARLY_SLOTS.append((p_, t0_))
    C_XV = WARP_N // 8  # 16-byte chunks per staged row
    assert PF == 0 or (PF >= 3 and SPLIT == 1 and not JIT_A)
    # L2 prefetch probes per K block: one 4-byte LDS-DMA load per row (PF_SPLIT per 128-byte row block)
    PF_A = (BM * PF_SPLIT + THREADS - 1) // THREADS if PF else 0
    PF_B = (BN * PF_SPLIT + THREADS - 1) // THREADS if PF else 0
    P = PF_A + PF_B
    PF_BYTES = 256 if PF else 0
    # C stores one wave issues per tile: each epilogue pass stores its staged chunks 64 lanes at a time
    N_ST = sum(
        ((min(MS, p_ * EP_F + EP_F) - p_ * EP_F) * 16 * C_XV + 63) // 64 for p_ in range((MS + EP_F - 1) // EP_F)
    )
    WALK = WALK0
    # XFER: the persistent walk's entry wait counts the previous tile's C stores (issued between the next tile's
    # two stages; the first tile issues as many dropped stores there), so it waits for stage 0 only, not their acks
    assert not XFER or (WALK and not JIT_A and not EARLY and A_DMA + B_DMA + P + N_ST <= _VMCNT_MAX)
    ENTRY_WAIT = 0 if JIT_A else A_DMA + B_DMA + P + (N_ST if XFER else 0) + (A_DMA if A3 else 0) + (B_DMA if B3 else 0)
    # A3: A streams through a three-stage ring (B keeps two), so A block kb + 3 loads while block kb computes: two K
    # steps of lookahead on A; only for a grid that loads no next tile under the epilogue
    assert not A3 or (SPLIT == 1 and not JIT_A and not PF and not XFER and (ONE_TILE or TILES % _CUS != 0))
    # B3: B streams through a three-stage ring (A keeps two): A's refill issues first, so the mid-step wait leaves
    # only B's in flight
    # A3 and B3 together: both operands stream through three-stage rings, each refill two K steps ahead
    assert not B3 or (SPLIT == 1 and not JIT_A and not PF and not XFER and (ONE_TILE or TILES % _CUS != 0))
    # the rings, the fold flag and the probe slot fit the CU's 160 KiB of LDS
    assert 2 * (AS_ELEMS + BS_ELEMS) <= 160 * 1024 - 384
    # KROT: KROT start points over the XCDs; a workgroup on XCD x walks K from block (x % KROT) * LOOPS // KROT and
    # wraps, so the XCDs miss on a B block one after another rather than together and the later ones find it in the MALL
    assert not KROT or (SPLIT == 1 and not PF and _XCDS % KROT == 0)

    # two waves a SIMD (8 waves) share its 512 registers: touch only the AGPRs the accumulators need
    AREG = 255 if WAVES == 4 else 4 * min(NF, _AGPR_FRAGS) - 1

    if DERIVE:
        return dict(locals())

    @fx.struct
    class SharedStorage:
        # the split fold's flag and the L2 probes' dummy slot follow the ring, only when used
        buf: fx.Array[fx.BFloat16, AS_ELEMS + BS_ELEMS + (64 + PF_BYTES // 2 if SPLIT > 1 or PF else 0), 16]

    @flyc.kernel(known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1])
    def gemm_family_tiled(A: fx.Tensor, B: fx.Tensor, C: fx.Tensor, W: fx.Tensor, m_rt: fx.Int32):
        # an AGPR use keeps LLVM from inferring the kernel needs none, so the accumulators may live in AGPRs
        llvm.InlineAsmOp(None, [], f"v_accvgpr_write_b32 a{AREG}, 0", f"~{{a{AREG}}}", has_side_effects=True)
        bf16x8 = fx.Vector.make_type(8, fx.BFloat16)
        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(SharedStorage)
        a_lds_ptr = lds.buf.peek().ptr
        b_lds_ptr = a_lds_ptr + fx.Int64(AS_ELEMS)
        a_lds_i64 = fx.Int64(fx.ptrtoint(a_lds_ptr))
        b_lds_i64 = fx.Int64(fx.ptrtoint(b_lds_ptr))
        m_i = m_rt if MRT else fx.Int32(m)
        mb_i = (m_rt + (BM - 1)) // BM if MRT else M_BLOCKS
        tiles_i = mb_i * N_BLOCKS if MRT else TILES
        # rows of A past m: their DMAs drop (MRT) or read row 0 (a static m)
        a_lim_i = m_rt if MRT else (m if M_BLOCKS * BM > m else None)
        c_rsrc = _rsrc(C, fx.Int64(m_rt) * (n * 2) if MRT else m * n * 2)
        flag_lds = _gep(_lds_ptr(a_lds_i64), fx.Int64((AS_ELEMS + BS_ELEMS) * 2))

        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
        wid = tid // 64
        lane = tid % 64
        bid = fx.block_idx.x
        x_q, x_r = tiles_i // _XCDS, tiles_i % _XCDS

        def tile_of(vb):
            """(m_off, n_off) of virtual block vb: XCD-major, then groups of GROUP_N column blocks walked row by
            row (with ROW_GROUPS: groups of GROUP_N row blocks walked column by column)."""
            xcd = vb % _XCDS
            logical = xcd * x_q + (xcd < x_r).select(xcd, x_r) + vb // _XCDS
            if const_expr(ROW_GROUPS):
                g_id = logical // (GROUP_N * N_BLOCKS)
                g_in = logical % (GROUP_N * N_BLOCKS)
                return (g_id * GROUP_N + g_in % GROUP_N) * BM, g_in // GROUP_N * BN
            g_id = logical // (GROUP_N * mb_i)
            g_in = logical % (GROUP_N * mb_i)
            block_n = g_id * GROUP_N + g_in % GROUP_N
            block_m = g_in // GROUP_N
            return block_m * BM, block_n * BN

        a_rsrc = _rsrc(A, fx.Int64(m_rt) * (k * 2) if MRT else m * k * 2)
        b_rsrc = _rsrc(B, n * k * 2)

        warp_m = wid // WN * WARP_M
        warp_n = wid % WN * WARP_N
        frag_r = lane % 16
        frag_k = lane // 16 * 8

        warp_offset = rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i64, fx.Int64(wid) * (64 * 16))

        def barrier(vmcnt):
            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
            llvm.InlineAsmOp(None, [], f"s_waitcnt vmcnt({vmcnt}) lgkmcnt(0)\n\ts_barrier", "", has_side_effects=True)
            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)

        def dma(rsrc, lds_ptr, goff, soff):
            llvm.InlineAsmOp(
                None,
                [lds_ptr, goff, rsrc, soff],
                "s_mov_b32 m0, $0\n\tbuffer_load_dwordx4 $1, $2, $3 offen sc0 lds",
                "s,v,s,s",
                has_side_effects=True,
            )

        def dma_ops(rsrc, lds_i64, rows, row_off, row_lim, count, kstep, stage, valid, kb0):
            """One closure per 16-byte DMA instruction of one operand's stage."""
            ops = []
            for ii in range_constexpr(count):

                def op(ii=ii):
                    gtid = THREADS * ii + tid
                    r = gtid // KV
                    col_bytes = (gtid % KV * 16) ^ (r % KV * 16)
                    row = row_off + r
                    if const_expr(row_lim is not None and not MRT):
                        row = (row < row_lim).select(row, 0)
                    # the per-lane offset stays the same over K; the K step rides the wave-uniform soffset, so the K loop
                    # computes no DMA address in VGPRs
                    goff = row * (k * 2) + col_bytes
                    if const_expr(KROT):
                        kabs = fx.Int32(kstep) + kb0
                        kabs = (kabs >= fx.Int32(LOOPS)).select(kabs - fx.Int32(LOOPS), kabs)
                        soff = rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, _as_i32(kabs * (_BK * 2)))
                    else:
                        soff = rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, _as_i32((fx.Int32(kstep) + kb0) * (_BK * 2)))
                    if const_expr(valid is not None):
                        # an invalid tile's loads fall past the descriptor and drop
                        goff = valid.select(goff, _OOB)
                    if const_expr(row_lim is not None and MRT):
                        goff = (row < row_lim).select(goff, _OOB)
                    if const_expr(isinstance(stage, int)):
                        base = lds_i64 + fx.Int64(stage * rows * _BK * 2 + ii * THREADS * 16)
                    else:
                        base = lds_i64 + fx.Int64(stage) * (rows * _BK * 2) + fx.Int64(ii * THREADS * 16)
                    dma(rsrc, _gep(_lds_ptr(base), warp_offset), _as_i32(goff), soff)

                ops.append(op)
            return ops

        pf_lds = _gep(_lds_ptr(a_lds_i64), fx.Int64((AS_ELEMS + BS_ELEMS) * 2 + 128))

        def pf_ops(kblk, tile):
            """P L2 prefetch probes of K block `kblk` of a work item into a dummy LDS region nothing reads: the
            line is in L2 when its DMA comes. Past the item's last block they drop."""
            m_off, n_off, valid, kb0 = tile
            a_lim = a_lim_i
            ops = []
            for rsrc, rows, row_off, row_lim, cnt in (
                (b_rsrc, BN, n_off, None, PF_B),
                (a_rsrc, BM, m_off, a_lim, PF_A),
            ):
                for ii in range_constexpr(cnt):

                    def op(ii=ii, rsrc=rsrc, rows=rows, row_off=row_off, row_lim=row_lim):
                        g = THREADS * ii + tid
                        r = g // PF_SPLIT
                        cb = g % PF_SPLIT * (128 // PF_SPLIT)
                        row = row_off + r
                        if const_expr(row_lim is not None):
                            row = (row < row_lim).select(row, 0)
                        goff = row * (k * 2) + cb
                        if const_expr((rows * PF_SPLIT) % THREADS != 0):
                            goff = (r < fx.Int32(rows)).select(goff, _OOB)
                        if const_expr(not isinstance(kblk, int)):
                            goff = (kblk < fx.Int32(LOOPS)).select(goff, _OOB)
                        if const_expr(valid is not None):
                            goff = valid.select(goff, _OOB)
                        soff = rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, _as_i32((fx.Int32(kblk) + kb0) * (_BK * 2)))
                        llvm.InlineAsmOp(
                            None,
                            [pf_lds, _as_i32(goff), rsrc, soff],
                            "s_mov_b32 m0, $0\n\tbuffer_load_dword $1, $2, $3 offen lds",
                            "s,v,s,s",
                            has_side_effects=True,
                        )

                    ops.append(op)
            return ops

        def dma_a(kstep, stage, tile):
            m_off, n_off, valid, kb0 = tile
            a_lim = a_lim_i
            return dma_ops(a_rsrc, a_lds_i64, BM, m_off, a_lim, A_DMA, kstep, stage, valid, kb0)

        def dma_stage(kstep, stage, tile, akstep=None, astage=None):
            """The DMAs of K block `kstep` of a work item (m_off, n_off, valid, first K block) into `stage` (with A3:
            B's; A's K block `akstep` into A stage `astage`)."""
            m_off, n_off, valid, kb0 = tile
            return dma_ops(b_rsrc, b_lds_i64, BN, n_off, None, B_DMA, kstep, stage, valid, kb0) + dma_a(
                kstep if akstep is None else akstep, stage if astage is None else astage, tile
            )

        def dma_b3(akstep, astage, bkstep, bstage, tile):
            """B3 refill: A's K block `akstep` into A stage `astage`, then B's `bkstep` into B stage `bstage`."""
            m_off, n_off, valid, kb0 = tile
            return dma_a(akstep, astage, tile) + dma_ops(b_rsrc, b_lds_i64, BN, n_off, None, B_DMA, bkstep, bstage, valid, kb0)

        def lds_frag(base_ptr, rows, stage, row, kcol):
            col_bytes = (kcol * 2) ^ (row % KV * 16)
            if const_expr(isinstance(stage, int)):
                s_off = fx.Int64(stage * rows * _BK)
            else:
                s_off = fx.Int64(stage) * (rows * _BK)
            off = s_off + fx.Int64(row) * _BK + fx.Int64(col_bytes // 2)
            return fx.ptr_load(base_ptr + off, result_type=bf16x8)

        def read_ops(stage, kk, ast=None):
            """Fragment reads of one 32-wide half: B columns, then A rows in the order the MFMAs consume them (A from
            stage `ast` when given)."""
            kcol = kk * 32 + frag_k
            ast = stage if ast is None else ast
            ops = []
            for j in range_constexpr(NS):
                ops.append(lambda j=j: lds_frag(b_lds_ptr, BN, stage, warp_n + j * 16 + frag_r, kcol))
            for i in range_constexpr(MS):
                ops.append(lambda i=i: lds_frag(a_lds_ptr, BM, ast, warp_m + i * 16 + frag_r, kcol))
            return ops

        def mma(acc_f, f, b, a):
            if const_expr(f < _AGPR_FRAGS):
                return rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16(T.vec(4, T.f32), [b, a, acc_f, 0, 0, 0])
            # LLVM keeps every MFMA of one form in one register file: past the AGPR file's 64 fragments the MFMA is
            # inline asm whose accumulator, tied to its output, stays in arch VGPRs. Its VALU zero fill is in the
            # loop preheader, 64 MFMAs ahead of the first read (two wait states needed)
            return llvm.InlineAsmOp(
                T.vec(4, T.f32),
                [fx.arith.unwrap(b), fx.arith.unwrap(a), fx.arith.unwrap(acc_f)],
                "v_mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16 $0, $1, $2, $3",
                "=v,v,v,0",
            ).result

        def mfma_half(acc, frags, reads, dmas, post=None):
            """MS*NS MFMAs on one half's fragments (B then A), with the next reads and the DMAs spread evenly
            between them in emission order."""
            b_fr = frags[:NS]
            a_fr = frags[NS:]
            out = list(acc)
            res = []
            total = MS * NS
            slots = {}
            rd0 = min(_RD_OFF, total // 2) if dmas else 0
            gap = _RD_GAP
            if const_expr(LATE_READS):
                # the next half's fragments load back to back, ending LATE_READS MFMAs before this half ends: fewer of
                # both halves' fragments are live at once, which a tile past 64 fragments needs to fit its VGPRs
                gap = 1
                rd0 = max(0, total - LATE_READS - len(reads))
            for q in range_constexpr(len(reads)):
                slots.setdefault(min(rd0 + q * gap, total - 1), []).append((reads[q], True))
            d_span = total
            if const_expr(DMA_FRONT and post is not None and EARLY_SLOTS):
                # DMA_FRONT: the next item's first-stage DMAs go out before the early passes' staging writes (1) or
                # stores (2), not queued behind the stores
                d_span = EARLY_SLOTS[0][1] + (E_RG + E_SG if DMA_FRONT == 2 else 0)
            for q in range_constexpr(len(dmas)):
                slots.setdefault(q * d_span // len(dmas), []).append((dmas[q], False))
            for t in range_constexpr(total):
                i = t // NS
                j = t % NS
                out[i * NS + j] = mma(out[i * NS + j], i * NS + j, b_fr[j], a_fr[i])
                for op, keep in slots.get(t, []):
                    r = op()
                    if const_expr(keep):
                        res.append(r)
                if const_expr(post is not None):
                    for op in post.get(t, []):
                        op(out)
                # a fence every two MFMAs keeps each read and DMA beside its slot
                if const_expr(t % 2 == 1):
                    rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
            return out, res

        def step(acc, f0, stage, dmas_of, read_next, bar=0, ast=None, ast_next=None, bst_next=None, post=None):
            """One K step from LDS stage `stage` (A3: A from stage `ast`, the next step's from `ast_next`), entered
            with its first half's fragments f0. Returns the accumulators and the next step's f0."""
            acc, f1 = mfma_half(acc, f0, read_ops(stage, 1, ast), [])
            # every wave's reads of this stage are done and the other stage has landed
            barrier(bar)
            dmas = dmas_of() if dmas_of is not None else []
            reads = read_ops(1 - stage if bst_next is None else bst_next, 0, ast_next) if read_next else []
            acc, nf0 = mfma_half(acc, f1, reads, dmas, post)
            return acc, nf0

        def jit_reads(stage, kk):
            """The reads a JIT_A half starts from: its B columns, then its first JIT_A A rows."""
            kcol = kk * 32 + frag_k
            ops = [lambda j=j: lds_frag(b_lds_ptr, BN, stage, warp_n + j * 16 + frag_r, kcol) for j in range_constexpr(NS)]
            return ops + [lambda i=i: lds_frag(a_lds_ptr, BM, stage, warp_m + i * 16 + frag_r, kcol) for i in range_constexpr(JIT_A)]

        def jit_half(acc, stage, kk, f, nxt, dmas, with_barrier):
            """MS*NS MFMAs of one 32-wide half of `stage`, entered with its B columns and first JIT_A A rows f: A row
            r loads JIT_A rows ahead of its MFMAs; `dmas` (the other stage's refills) spread over the half; with_barrier:
            after this half's last A read, wait for the other stage and for every wave's reads of this one, then load
            `nxt` (the next half's first reads) in the last slots."""
            total = MS * NS
            out = list(acc)
            b_fr = f[:NS]
            a_fr = list(f[NS:]) + [None] * (MS - JIT_A)
            slots = {}
            for r in range_constexpr(JIT_A, MS):
                slots.setdefault((r - JIT_A) * NS, []).append(("a", r))
            first_free = 0
            if const_expr(with_barrier):
                bslot = min(total - 1, (MS - 1 - JIT_A) * NS + _JIT_BARRIER_GAP)
                slots.setdefault(bslot, []).append(("bar", 0))
                first_free = bslot + 1
            for q in range_constexpr(len(dmas)):
                slots.setdefault(q * total // len(dmas), []).append(("dma", q))
            nn = len(nxt)
            r0 = max(first_free, total - LATE_READS - nn)
            # B column 0 and A row 0 first: the next half's first MFMA needs them
            order = [0, NS] + list(range(1, NS)) + list(range(NS + 1, nn)) if nn else []
            for p_ in range_constexpr(nn):
                slots.setdefault(min(r0 + p_, total - 1), []).append(("nxt", order[p_]))
            res = [None] * nn
            kcol = kk * 32 + frag_k
            for t in range_constexpr(total):
                i = t // NS
                j = t % NS
                out[i * NS + j] = mma(out[i * NS + j], i * NS + j, b_fr[j], a_fr[i])
                for kind, q in slots.get(t, []):
                    if const_expr(kind == "a"):
                        a_fr[q] = lds_frag(a_lds_ptr, BM, stage, warp_m + q * 16 + frag_r, kcol)
                    elif const_expr(kind == "bar"):
                        barrier(0)
                    elif const_expr(kind == "dma"):
                        dmas[q]()
                    else:
                        res[q] = nxt[q]()
                if const_expr(t % 2 == 1):
                    rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
            return out, res

        def jit_step(acc, f0, stage, dmas_of, read_next):
            """One K step of the JIT_A loop: the first half refills the other stage (free since the previous step's
            barrier); the second half's barrier waits for those loads and for every wave's reads of this stage."""
            dmas = dmas_of() if dmas_of is not None else []
            acc, f1 = jit_half(acc, stage, 0, f0, jit_reads(stage, 1), dmas, False)
            reads = jit_reads(1 - stage, 0) if read_next else []
            return jit_half(acc, stage, 1, f1, reads, [], True)

        # this wave's private C staging: its half of the second stage of A or B (WIDE_EP: its quarter of the ring)
        if const_expr(WIDE_EP):
            stage_base = wid * ((AS_ELEMS + BS_ELEMS) // WAVES)
        else:
            stage_base = (wid < WAVES // 2).select(
                wid * (BM * _BK // (WAVES // 2)) + BM * _BK,
                (wid - WAVES // 2) * (BN * _BK // (WAVES // 2)) + AS_ELEMS + BN * _BK,
            )
        c_lds_ptr = a_lds_ptr + fx.Int64(stage_base)

        def k_loop(cur, nk, last_dmas, post=None):
            """The nk K blocks of work item `cur`, whose first two stages are in flight; `last_dmas` loads the next
            item's first stage once both stages are free."""
            # JIT_A: only the first stage is in flight; the first step's first half loads the second
            barrier(ENTRY_WAIT)
            f0 = [op() for op in (jit_reads(0, 0) if JIT_A else read_ops(0, 0))]
            acc = [arith.constant_vector(0.0, T.vec(4, T.f32))] * NF
            nfr = len(f0)
            stp = jit_step if JIT_A else step
            # K block whose stage a step's refill loads: the next one into the other stage (JIT_A), else two ahead
            ahead = 1 if JIT_A else 2
            init_state = [fx.Int32(0)] + acc + f0
            for _it, state in range(0, nk // 2 - 1, 1, init=init_state):
                kb = state[0]
                acc = state[1 : 1 + NF]
                f0 = state[1 + NF :]
                if const_expr(A3 and B3):
                    # block kb + 3 refills stage kb % 3 of both rings, freed by this step's barrier
                    s0 = kb % 3
                    s1 = (kb + 1) % 3
                    s2 = (kb + 2) % 3
                    acc, f0 = step(
                        acc, f0, s0, lambda kb=kb, s0=s0: dma_stage(kb + fx.Int32(3), s0, cur), True, A_DMA + B_DMA, s0, s1, s1
                    )
                    acc, f0 = step(
                        acc, f0, s1, lambda kb=kb, s1=s1: dma_stage(kb + fx.Int32(4), s1, cur), True, A_DMA + B_DMA, s1, s2, s2
                    )
                elif const_expr(A3):
                    # A block kb + 3 refills A stage kb % 3, freed by this step's barrier
                    a0 = kb % 3
                    a1 = (kb + 1) % 3
                    a2 = (kb + 2) % 3
                    acc, f0 = step(
                        acc, f0, 0, lambda kb=kb, a0=a0: dma_stage(kb + fx.Int32(2), 0, cur, kb + fx.Int32(3), a0), True, A_DMA, a0, a1
                    )
                    acc, f0 = step(
                        acc, f0, 1, lambda kb=kb, a1=a1: dma_stage(kb + fx.Int32(3), 1, cur, kb + fx.Int32(4), a1), True, A_DMA, a1, a2
                    )
                elif const_expr(B3):
                    # B block kb + 3 refills B stage kb % 3 after A block kb + 2, both freed by this step's barrier
                    b0 = kb % 3
                    b1 = (kb + 1) % 3
                    b2 = (kb + 2) % 3
                    acc, f0 = step(
                        acc, f0, b0, lambda kb=kb, b0=b0: dma_b3(kb + fx.Int32(2), 0, kb + fx.Int32(3), b0, cur), True, B_DMA, 0, 1, b1
                    )
                    acc, f0 = step(
                        acc, f0, b1, lambda kb=kb, b1=b1: dma_b3(kb + fx.Int32(3), 1, kb + fx.Int32(4), b1, cur), True, B_DMA, 1, 0, b2
                    )
                elif const_expr(PF):
                    acc, f0 = step(
                        acc, f0, 0, lambda kb=kb: dma_stage(kb + fx.Int32(2), 0, cur) + pf_ops(kb + fx.Int32(PF), cur), True, P
                    )
                    acc, f0 = step(
                        acc, f0, 1, lambda kb=kb: dma_stage(kb + fx.Int32(3), 1, cur) + pf_ops(kb + fx.Int32(PF + 1), cur), True, P
                    )
                else:
                    acc, f0 = stp(acc, f0, 0, lambda kb=kb: dma_stage(kb + fx.Int32(ahead), ahead % 2, cur), True)
                    acc, f0 = stp(acc, f0, 1, lambda kb=kb: dma_stage(kb + fx.Int32(ahead + 1), 1 - ahead % 2, cur), True)
                results = yield [kb + fx.Int32(2)] + acc + f0
            kb = results[0]
            acc = results[1 : 1 + NF]
            f0 = results[1 + NF : 1 + NF + nfr]
            if const_expr(A3 and B3):
                acc, f0 = step(acc, f0, (nk - 2) % 3, None, True, A_DMA + B_DMA, (nk - 2) % 3, (nk - 1) % 3, (nk - 1) % 3)
            elif const_expr(A3):
                acc, f0 = step(acc, f0, 0, None, True, A_DMA, (nk - 2) % 3, (nk - 1) % 3)
            elif const_expr(B3):
                acc, f0 = step(acc, f0, (nk - 2) % 3, None, True, B_DMA, 0, 1, (nk - 1) % 3)
            elif const_expr(PF):
                acc, f0 = step(acc, f0, 0, None, True, P)
            else:
                acc, f0 = stp(acc, f0, 0, (lambda: dma_stage(kb + fx.Int32(1), 1, cur)) if JIT_A else None, True)
            # both stages are free past this barrier: the next item's first stage loads
            if const_expr(A3 and B3):
                acc, _ = step(acc, f0, (nk - 1) % 3, last_dmas, False, 0, (nk - 1) % 3, post=post)
            elif const_expr(A3):
                acc, _ = step(acc, f0, 1, last_dmas, False, 0, (nk - 1) % 3, post=post)
            elif const_expr(B3):
                acc, _ = step(acc, f0, (nk - 1) % 3, last_dmas, False, 0, 1, post=post)
            elif const_expr(post is not None):
                acc, _ = step(acc, f0, 1, last_dmas, False, post=post)
            else:
                acc, _ = stp(acc, f0, 1, last_dmas, False)
            if const_expr(NF > _AGPR_FRAGS):
                # the hazard recognizer cannot see an MFMA inside inline asm: wait out its 4-pass result (8 wait
                # states) before a VALU reads or rewrites the VGPR accumulators
                rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
                llvm.InlineAsmOp(None, [], "s_nop 7\n\ts_nop 7", "", has_side_effects=True)
                rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
            return acc

        N_PASS = (MS + EP_F - 1) // EP_F

        def store_pass(p, m_off, n_off):
            """Epilogue pass p as three phases: round its fragment rows to bf16 into this wave's staging, read the
            staged chunks back, store them."""
            c_r = lane % 16
            c_c = lane // 16 * 4
            i0 = p * EP_F
            i1 = min(MS, i0 + EP_F)
            chunks = (i1 - i0) * 16 * C_XV
            vals = []

            def w(frag):
                for i in range_constexpr(i0, i1):
                    for j in range_constexpr(NS):
                        cast = Vector(frag(i * NS + j)).to(fx.BFloat16)
                        lrow = (i - i0) * 16 + c_r
                        lcol = j * 16 + c_c
                        fx.ptr_store(cast, c_lds_ptr + fx.Int64(lrow * CP + lcol))

            def r():
                for q in range_constexpr((chunks + 63) // 64):
                    g = q * 64 + lane
                    rr = g // C_XV
                    cc = g % C_XV * 8
                    ragged = chunks % 64 != 0 and q == chunks // 64
                    if const_expr(ragged):
                        rr = (g < fx.Int32(chunks)).select(rr, 0)
                    vals.append((fx.ptr_load(c_lds_ptr + fx.Int64(rr * CP + cc), result_type=bf16x8), g, rr, cc, ragged))

            def s_():
                for v, g, rr, cc, ragged in vals:
                    row = m_off + warp_m + i0 * 16 + rr
                    off = (row * n + n_off + warp_n + cc) * 2
                    live = row < m_i
                    if const_expr(N_TAIL):
                        live = live & (n_off + warp_n + cc < fx.Int32(n))
                    if const_expr(ragged):
                        live = live & (g < fx.Int32(chunks))
                    _bstore(v, c_rsrc, live.select(off, _OOB), C_AUX)

            return w, r, s_

        def store_c(m_off, n_off, frag, p0=0):
            """Round frag(f) to bf16 and store the tile, a few fragment rows at a time through this wave's staging
            (from pass p0: the earlier ones went out under the last MFMAs)."""
            for p in range_constexpr(p0, N_PASS):
                w, r, s_ = store_pass(p, m_off, n_off)
                w(frag)
                r()
                s_()

        def early_post(m_off, n_off):
            """EARLY: the epilogue passes whose fragment rows finish early in the last half step, placed EARLY MFMAs
            after their rows' last MFMA (staging writes), E_RG later (reads), E_SG later still (stores); returns the
            slots and the first pass left for after the loop."""
            post = {}
            for p, t0 in EARLY_SLOTS:
                w, r, s_ = store_pass(p, m_off, n_off)
                post.setdefault(t0, []).append(lambda out, w=w: w(lambda f: out[f]))
                post.setdefault(t0 + E_RG, []).append(lambda out, r=r: r())
                post.setdefault(t0 + E_RG + E_SG, []).append(lambda out, s_=s_: s_())
            return post, len(EARLY_SLOTS)

        # this workgroup's split item: the splits of a tile are adjacent in an XCD-major order, so they share an
        # XCD's L2
        if const_expr(TAIL):
            p_q, p_r = PROD // _XCDS, PROD % _XCDS
            p_x = bid % _XCDS
            item = p_x * p_q + (p_x < p_r).select(p_x, p_r) + bid // _XCDS
            t_split = item % SPLIT
            t_tile = item // SPLIT
            t_m, t_n = tile_of(ROUNDS * HEAD + t_tile)
            tail_item = (t_m, t_n, None, t_split * KB_S)

        # first K block of this workgroup's items
        rot = 0
        if const_expr(KROT):
            rot = fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, _as_i32((bid % _XCDS % KROT) * LOOPS // KROT)))
        if const_expr(ROUNDS):
            m0_off, n0_off = tile_of(bid)
            first = (m0_off, n0_off, None, rot)
        else:
            first = tail_item
        if const_expr(STAGGER):
            # STAGGER: some of the first round's workgroups start STAGGER x STAG_N s_sleep units late, so their C
            # store bursts fall outside the others' (mode 0: every other one per XCD; modes 1, 2, 3: one in 8, 16 or 4
            # per XCD). One inline-asm block: the branch adds no basic block around the loop
            xb = bid // _XCDS
            if const_expr(STAG_MODE == 0):
                sel = xb % 2 == 1
                if const_expr(GRID > _CUS):
                    sel = sel & (bid < fx.Int32(_CUS))
            else:
                per = {1: 8, 2: 16, 3: 4}[STAG_MODE]
                sel = (bid < fx.Int32(_CUS)) & (xb % per == per - 1)
            sflag = rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, _as_i32(sel.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))))
            tot = STAGGER * STAG_N
            sleeps = "\n\t".join(f"s_sleep {min(127, tot - q)}" for q in range(0, tot, 127))
            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
            llvm.InlineAsmOp(
                None, [sflag], f"s_cmp_eq_u32 $0, 0\n\ts_cbranch_scc1 1f\n\t{sleeps}\n1:", "s,~{scc}", has_side_effects=True
            )
            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
        for op in dma_stage(0, 0, first):
            op()
        if const_expr(XFER):
            # the stores a later tile's entry finds between its two stages, here dropped
            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
            zero = arith.constant_vector(0.0, T.vec(4, T.f32))
            for q in range_constexpr(N_ST):
                # distinct offsets, all past the buffer: LLVM would fold repeated stores to one address into one
                _bstore(zero, c_rsrc, _OOB - 16 * q, C_AUX)
            rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
        if const_expr(not JIT_A):
            b3_pre = dma_ops(b_rsrc, b_lds_i64, BN, first[1], None, B_DMA, 2, 2, first[2], first[3]) if B3 else []
            for op in dma_stage(1, 1, first) + pf_ops(PF - 1, first) + (dma_a(2, 2, first) if A3 else []) + b3_pre:
                op()
        if const_expr(ROUNDS):
            n_rounds = arith.index_cast(T.index, _as_i32(tiles_i // _CUS)) if MRT and WALK_RT else ROUNDS
            for t in range(0, n_rounds, 1):
                vb = bid + t * HEAD
                m_off, n_off = tile_of(vb)
                cur = (m_off, n_off, None, rot)
                nxt = None
                if const_expr(HEAD == _CUS and not ONE_TILE):
                    vn = vb + HEAD
                    nm_off, nn_off = tile_of(vn)
                    in_head = vn < (tiles_i if MRT else fx.Int32(TILES))
                    nxt = (nm_off, nn_off, in_head, rot)
                post, p_late = early_post(m_off, n_off) if EARLY else (None, 0)
                acc = k_loop(cur, LOOPS, None if nxt is None else functools.partial(dma_stage, 0, 0, nxt), post)
                store_c(m_off, n_off, lambda f, acc=acc: acc[f], p_late)
                if const_expr(nxt is not None and not JIT_A):
                    # every wave has read its staged C back before the second stage refills
                    barrier(_VMCNT_MAX)
                    for op in dma_stage(1, 1, nxt) + pf_ops(PF - 1, nxt):
                        op()

        def tail():
            acc = k_loop(tail_item, KB_S, None)
            w_rsrc = _rsrc(W, ws_bytes)

            # fragment-major planes: (tile, split, wave, fragment, lane) x f32x4
            def plane_off(sp, f):
                return (((t_tile * SPLIT + sp) * 4 + wid) * NF + f) * 1024 + lane * 16

            for f in range_constexpr(NF):
                _bstore(Vector(acc[f]), w_rsrc, plane_off(t_split, f), _SC01)
            rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
            gpu.barrier()
            if tid == fx.Int32(0):
                # launch tag: dispatch id plus queue address bits (ids restart on another queue)
                did = llvm.call_intrinsic(T.i64, "llvm.amdgcn.dispatch.id", [], [], [])
                qp = llvm.call_intrinsic(ir.Type.parse("!llvm.ptr<4>"), "llvm.amdgcn.queue.ptr", [], [], [])
                qpi = llvm.PtrToIntOp(T.i64, qp).result
                tag = std_arith.AndIOp(
                    std_arith.AddIOp(did, std_arith.MulIOp(qpi, _i64c(_TAG_MUL - (1 << 64))).result).result,
                    _i64c(_TAG_MASK),
                ).result
                tag_base = std_arith.ShLIOp(tag, _i64c(8)).result
                cnt_off = std_arith.ExtSIOp(T.i64, _as_i32(t_tile * _CNT_LINE + plane_bytes)).result
                cptr = _gep(fx.to_llvm_ptr(fx.get_iter(W)), cnt_off)
                cnt = llvm.LoadOp(T.i64, cptr, alignment=8, ordering=llvm.AtomicOrdering.monotonic, syncscope="agent")
                stale = std_arith.CmpIOp(
                    std_arith.CmpIPredicate.ne, std_arith.ShRUIOp(cnt.result, _i64c(8)).result, tag
                ).result
                # a word from another launch is reset to this launch's tag with count 0; a word that already holds
                # the tag is left alone (its expected value is one no tagged word can hold)
                expect = std_arith.SelectOp(stale, cnt.result, _i64c(-1)).result
                llvm.cmpxchg(
                    cptr,
                    expect,
                    tag_base,
                    llvm.AtomicOrdering.monotonic,
                    llvm.AtomicOrdering.monotonic,
                    syncscope="agent",
                    alignment=8,
                )
                old = llvm.atomicrmw(
                    llvm.AtomicBinOp.add, cptr, _i64c(1), llvm.AtomicOrdering.monotonic, syncscope="agent", alignment=8
                )
                last = std_arith.CmpIOp(
                    std_arith.CmpIPredicate.eq, old, std_arith.OrIOp(tag_base, _i64c(SPLIT - 1)).result
                ).result
                llvm.StoreOp(std_arith.ExtUIOp(T.i32, last).result, flag_lds, alignment=4)
            gpu.barrier()
            is_last = fx.Int32(llvm.LoadOp(T.i32, flag_lds, alignment=4).result)
            if is_last == fx.Int32(1):

                def folded(f):
                    # one add commutes: own + other gives the same bits whichever split folds
                    other = Vector(_bload(T.f32x4, w_rsrc, plane_off(1 - t_split, f), _SC01))
                    return Vector(acc[f]) + other

                store_c(t_m, t_n, folded)

        if const_expr(TAIL):
            tail()

    if MRT:

        @flyc.jit
        def launch(A: fx.Tensor, B: fx.Tensor, C: fx.Tensor, W: fx.Tensor, m: fx.Int32, grid: fx.Int32, stream: fx.Stream):
            gemm_family_tiled(A, B, C, W, m).launch(grid=(fx.Int64(grid), 1, 1), block=(THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream)

        return launch, 0

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(A: fx.Tensor, B: fx.Tensor, C: fx.Tensor, W: fx.Tensor, stream: fx.Stream):
        gemm_family_tiled(A, B, C, W, fx.Int32(m)).launch(grid=(GRID, 1, 1), block=(THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream)

    return launch, ws_bytes // 4

        JIT_A=0, PF=0, PF_SPLIT=1, XFER=0, C_AUX=C_AUX, A3=A3, B3=B3, KROT=KROT, EPF=EPF, EARLY=EARLY, E_RG=2, E_SG=2,
